brainlife.desc: Directory of several DSI Studio TinyTrack (.tt.gz) files, typically one per tract from automatic tract segmentation.
brainlife.name: neuro/dsistudio/tinytrack-s

original.desc: multi-file version of track/tinytrack. It contains multiple *.tt.gz inside a single directory

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Per-tract conversion to .trk and DSI Studio analyses.

**Not for:** Apps that need a single tractogram.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.dsistudio.tinytrack-s.json

identifying_risks: Individual white matter geometry can support re-linkage as a structural fingerprint
Headers and metadata may carry subject codes or acquisition dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers. Tier 4 conditions apply if used as a connectome fingerprint.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Strip free-text tags and dates from metadata before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only once aggregated across participants (e.g. a population atlas)
Tier 4 if used to build connectome fingerprints or predictive features

intended_use: Per-tract conversion to .trk and DSI Studio analyses.
not_suitable_for: Apps that need a single tractogram.

outputs_of.name: dsi-studio-atk
outputs_of.purpose: DSI Studio automatic tract tracking and segmentation
